newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: IAWS, ACT looking at Bell Lines rescue - paper.
newsitem.headline: IAWS, ACT looking at Bell Lines rescue - paper.

text.p: IAWS Group Plc and venture capital group ACT have emerged as the front-runners to put together a rescue package for Bell Lines along with senior members of the shipping company's management, the Irish Times reported on Tuesday.
Walter Hobs of ACT Venture Capital confirmed that his company was engaged in trying to hammer out a deal.
"We are part of a consortium that is actively looking at an investment in Bell Lines," he told the newspaper.
Agricultural wholesaler IAWS declined to comment.
On Monday, the examiner to the troubled shipping group, David Hughes, was given a further week by the High Court to agree a deal with the new consortium.
Bell Lines went into examinership in February, owing some six million Irish pounds to secured creditors and 25 million to unsecured creditors.

An earlier rescue plan involving Irish Continental Group and two venture capital firms, NatWest Ventures and CVC Capital Partners, collapsed earlier this month, just minutes before it was due to be considered by the High Court.
